rule: Incoming user requests cue DP selection. Payment finalizes DP. DP fulfillment proceeds through QA/QC and proof.

terms.KK: selected/cut music moment, not automatically public product
terms.II: finished customer-ready delivery audio object with front padding, KK audio, back padding, and Twinkle baked in
